notes: Clock replay uses the installed Phaser TimeStep for the legacy accumulator and the production BattleInputClock for the new deadlines.
Clock replay is deterministic modelled DOM delivery, main-thread stalls and timer jitter; no rendering, network, RTT or server-confirm timing is simulated.
Profile fixtures have modelled combat in the browser, not a production network. RTT and confirm fields in harness output are not production latency measurements.
Scene/Phaser work excludes input work now scheduled outside render frames. Total main-thread CDP measurements are retained below.
